channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ryan Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ryan Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Ryan Smith
item.description:
“And I’m grateful for [new Jazz owner Ryan Smith]. He’s doing some terrific things with the franchise and has a vision for how it can continue to grow. My tenure here has obviously — eight years again — you know, it speaks to the situation and I think I’m proud of what we have had an opportunity to build. That’s coaches, players, management and ownership — everybody.”

Quin Snyder on Ryan Smith, Mar 23, 2022. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Ryan Smith
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Justin Zanik on new @utahjazz owner Ryan Smith:

“Ryan's resources and commitment to spending are going to be at levels that we've never done with the Jazz.”

Justin Zanik on Ryan Smith, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Ryan Smith
item.description:
Eric Walden:Dennis Lindsey, on the impact of new owner Ryan Smith:

“It's only natural that his preferences and inclinations will move us in new directions.”

Dennis Lindsey on Ryan Smith, Jun 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Ryan Smith
item.description:
Eric Walden:Donovan, on new Jazz owner Ryan Smith:

“He's a guy who’s passionate about what he does, locked in on the ultimate goal. … He came in and spoke to us a few days ago, which was nice … he trusts that the basketball minds are good at what they do.”

Donovan Mitchell on Ryan Smith, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.
